content.value: A 4-pole 3-phase induction motor operates from a supply whose frequency is 50 Hz. 10 10 Calculate i) The speed at which the magnetic field of the stator is rotating,
ii) The speed of the rotor when slip is 0.04.
ii) The frequency of the rotor currents when the slip is 0.03.
iv) The frequency of the rotor currents at stand still.
